steps.command: Existing required Linux, Windows and real Windows packaging CI

behavioralRequirements: CreateWorkflowRun commits exactly one WorkflowRunCreated event at version 1
Reopen real SQLite and replay identical workflow state
Identical command retry returns stored outcome without a second event, including after restart
Malformed commands, hashes and unsupported semantics reject without writes
Changed-payload identity conflicts and optimistic concurrency are explicit
Replay rejects corrupt hash, stream identity or noncontiguous versions
Failed transactions do not leave partial event or audit effects
completionBoundary: Do not claim this slice complete until all steps have exact-subject evidence; this slice never means the whole Phase 2 roadmap is complete.
